```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import DREAM
from DREAM import DREAMSettings, runiface

# --- Initialization Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings()

# Set up radial grid
ds.radialgrid.setNr(10)
ds.radialgrid.setMinorRadius(0.22)
ds.radialgrid.setWallRadius(0.23)

# Set time steps
ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-3)
ds.timestep.setNt(10)

# Add ions (example: deuterium plasma with some argon impurity)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='D', Z=1, n=5e19)
ds.eqsys.n_i.addIon(name='Ar', Z=18, n=1e17)

# Set up temperature and electric field
Te0 = 1e3  # eV
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(Te0)
ds.eqsys.E_field.setInitialProfile(0.1)  # V/m

# Disable runaway and hot-tail grid
ds.hottailgrid.setEnabled(False)
ds.runawaygrid.setEnabled(False)

# Save settings and run initialization
ds.save('settings_init.h5')
do = runiface(ds, 'output_init.h5', quiet=True)

# --- Ionization Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_init.h5')
ds.eqsys.n_i.setIonization(True)
ds.save('settings_ionization.h5')
do = runiface(ds, 'output_ionization.h5', quiet=True)

# --- Equilibration Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_ionization.h5')
ds.eqsys.n_i.setIonization(True)
ds.eqsys.T_cold.setType(DREAM.EQUILIBRIUM)
ds.save('settings_equilibration.h5')
do = runiface(ds, 'output_equilibration.h5', quiet=True)

# --- Radiation Stage ---
ds = DREAMSettings('settings_equilibration.h5')
ds.eqsys.n_i.setRecombinationRadiation(True)
ds.save('settings_radiation.h5')
do = runiface(ds, 'output_radiation.h5', quiet=True)

# --- Plotting Ohmic Heating and Radiative Losses vs Temperature ---

# Define temperature range
Te_range = np.logspace(1, 4, 100)  # eV

ohmic_heating = []
radiative_losses = []

for Te in Te_range:
    ds = DREAMSettings('settings_radiation.h5')
    ds.eqsys.T_cold.setInitialProfile(Te)
    ds.timestep.setTmax(1e-6)
    ds.timestep.setNt(2)
    ds.save('settings_scan.h5')
    do = runiface(ds, 'output_scan.h5', quiet=True)
    # Extract ohmic heating and radiative losses at center
    ohmic = do.other.fluid['OhmicHeating'][0,0]
    rad = do.other.fluid['RadiatedPower'][0,0]
    ohmic_heating.append(ohmic)
    radiative_losses.append(rad)

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
plt.loglog(Te_range, ohmic_heating, label='Ohmic Heating')
plt.loglog(Te_range, np.abs(radiative_losses), label='Radiative Losses')
plt.xlabel('Electron Temperature [eV]')
plt.ylabel('Power Density [W/m$^3$]')
plt.title('Ohmic Heating and Radiative Losses vs Temperature')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, which='both', ls='--')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
